title: Revamp audio bus UI
body:
<!--

Closes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116073

Initially this started as a fix for the issue above. However as I looked more into the audio bus, the more problems I found.

This PR fixes many related things, and finishes up with a new (but important) look to the VU meter.

Here's what I have fixed:

- Moved slider level preview so it no longer blocks the view of the VU meter
- Removed extra padding on the notches so it matches the height of the VU meter
- Added positive and negative signs to the dB levels to avoid confusion
- Separated "dB" from dB number and removed unnecessary decimals so there's less clutter
- Fixed a bug where VU meter wouldn't work in some cases
- Changed how VU meter scales so it matches actual dB value
- Added a peak indicator so users can see better at which level their audio peaks at
- Changed VU meter texture
- Minor changes: using UID and fixing typo in a comment

There are plenty of reasons why I changed the VU meter texture:
- Improve clarity
In the original texture, it was very hard to tell where the peak was

- Emphasize clipping
In the original texture, the gradient changed to red only at the very top and way to smoothly. It doesn't give enough feedback that the audio is clipping, and the importance of it

- Remove unnecessary gap
There is a gap in the original texture, which I assume was meant to show where 0 dB sits. Not only is it in the wrong place, but also the gap size doesn't match the notches in the texture (which also don't mean anything AFAIK)

- Improve customizability
The colors of the old meter come with the texture. So the only way to change the colors AFAIK, was by either using modulate, or changing the texture. This PR brings editor settings to change the colors of the meter

- Match the rest of the editor
Godot now has a more cleaner and modern look. In my opinion, this change on the meter makes it fit the editor better

What I didn't do:
- Delete the old texture
That could be used to change to the previous look if a user decides to. And I'm wasn't sure if removing it would break anything

I hope these are good changes. I'm happy with them, but I understand changing the appearance of the VU meter is a big one. I could change back to the previous one if really needed, and try to fix the gap too.
